summary: Probably John's 3rd-great-grand-aunt; shown in the tree as 'Lina Ann Harrison 1839-1910'.
bio: The 1850 census lists 'Leva Ann', 11, in James Pringle's household. The tree shows Andrew's sibling card 'Lina Ann Harrison 1839-1910'. No online source names a Pringle-Harrison marriage in Luzerne (Bradsby, Harvey, Luzerne wills index and web search all negative). The Harrison married name and 1910 death are tree-only (unverified).
sources: 1850 US census, Plymouth Twp, Luzerne Co., PA, enumerated 14 Sep 1850 by A. Atherton, Ass't Marshal, page 140/141 (stamp 71), NARA M432; dwelling 944 / family 964 (James Pringle household); FamilySearch record attached to tree person Andrew Pringle 1836-1900, FamilySearch ID KG4S-XMF (screenshot IMG_7813)
Johnny Meier's Ancestry tree (screenshots IMG_7791-7840 in John's Google Drive), transcribed in research/tree_transcription.md and Ancestry tree screenshots (section 2.2.2)
